# Implementation Plan: F1
<!-- Generated by /plan -->

**Title:** Swift workspace, shared kit, and the three targets
**Spec ID:** F1
**Spec:** planning/specs/spec-F1.md
**Plan size:** Large

## Task

Replace the hand-rolled `app/MCPRouter.xcodeproj` with a generated workspace: one SwiftPM
library (`MCPRouterKit`) plus two app targets (macOS unsandboxed direct-distribution, iOS
sandboxed), driven by XcodeGen. Add lint/format config, a single `make` entry point, a CI
workflow, and `planning/practices/SWIFT_PRACTICES.md` — the binding Swift house style that does
not exist yet and that every runner after this one needs. Nothing the shipped TypeScript router
does changes.

## Approach

Everything Apple lives under `app/`. One directory holds **both** `Package.swift` and
`project.yml`: SwiftPM owns the library and its tests (fast, Xcode-free `swift test`), XcodeGen
owns the two app targets and consumes the package as a local dependency at `path: .`.

**Measured, not assumed.** A spike at `/tmp/xgspike` on 2026-08-13 built this end to end on this
machine: `xcodegen generate` emitted the project, the macOS target linked the local package
product, referenced a symbol from it, and `xcodebuild … CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build` reported
`** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`. The same spike verified the two mechanisms the plan leans on:
`swift test list` enumerates tests in a stable machine-countable form, and a `CaseIterable`
raw-value enum with a computed value compiles and yields `allCases`. Toolchain: XcodeGen 2.45.4,
Xcode 26.6, Swift 6.3.3, SDKs macOS 26.5 / iOS 26.5.

Both `.xcodeproj` and the generated `Info.plist`s become build artifacts and leave git — the point
of generating them, and it removes the `project.pbxproj` merge conflicts that would otherwise hit
every parallel runner in this fleet.

## Reference implementation

No Swift analogue exists in this repo. The grounded references:

- `src/control.ts` (`describe()`, ~line 146) — the wire shape the kit's DTOs mirror.
- `app/Sources/Core/Models.swift` — an already-faithful Swift transcription of that shape; port.
- `app/Sources/Design/Theme.swift` (`shortAgo`, `projectLabel`) — port the formatters only.
- `planning/practices/CODING_PRACTICES.md` — the shape `SWIFT_PRACTICES.md` must match.

## Prerequisites

XcodeGen 2.45.4, SwiftLint 0.65.0, SwiftFormat 0.62.1 — present on this machine. The Makefile must
fail with a readable message when any is absent, never skip the gate silently.

## Steps

### 1. Create the new source tree and shells FIRST
- **Files:** `app/MCPRouter/MCPRouterApp.swift`, `app/MCPRouterIOS/MCPRouterIOSApp.swift`,
  `app/Sources/MCPRouterKit/`, `app/Tests/MCPRouterKitTests/` — **Create**
- **Details:** Directories and shells exist before anything generates a project, because XcodeGen
  rejects a target whose source path is missing, and files added after generation do not enter an
  already-generated project. Ordering fix: shells → package → generate.
- **Verify:** directories exist.

### 2. Retire the hand-rolled project and the superseded views
- **Files:** `app/MCPRouter.xcodeproj/**`, `app/Info.plist`, `app/Sources/Core/`,
  `app/Sources/Design/`, `app/Sources/MenuBar/`, `app/Sources/Window/`,
  `app/Sources/MCPRouterApp.swift` — **Delete**
- **Action:** `git rm -r` the tracked project and the 13 superseded view files; extend `.gitignore`
  with `*.xcodeproj/` and `app/**/Info.plist`.
- **Details:** The deletion is explicit, not implied — leaving the old tree in place would let
  `Theme.swift`'s off-`DESIGN.md` palette and the M1–M8 views compile into the new targets.
  **Move `app/Sources/Assets.xcassets/` to `app/MCPRouter/Assets.xcassets/` first** — the AppIcon
  set is authored art and is kept.
- **Verify:** `git ls-files app | grep -cE 'xcodeproj|Window/|MenuBar/'` → 0;
  the AppIcon set still tracked.
- **Fulfils:** A1

### 3. The package manifest
- **File:** `app/Package.swift` — **Create**
- **Details:** `swift-tools-version: 6.0`; name `MCPRouterKit`; platforms `.macOS(.v15)`,
  `.iOS(.v18)`; one library product; one target; one Swift Testing test target.
  `SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY: complete`. **No external dependencies** — the MCP SDK is R1's to add
  and to pin exactly.
- **Verify:** deferred to step 8 — the package has no sources until steps 4–7, so verifying here
  could only fail.
- **Fulfils:** A4, A14

### 4. The token registry — enumerable by construction
- **Files:** `app/Sources/MCPRouterKit/Design/ColorToken.swift`,
  `…/Design/TypeToken.swift`, `…/Design/MetricToken.swift` — **Create**
- **Details:** Values only, no SwiftUI import — the presentation layer is F2's. Each family is a
  **`CaseIterable` raw-value enum whose raw value is the token's documented name**, with the value
  as a computed property:
  ```swift
  public enum ColorToken: String, CaseIterable, Sendable {
      case ground = "--ground"
      case t1 = "--t1"
      // …
      public var hex: String { switch self { case .ground: "#1E1E1E"; … } }
      public var opacity: Double { switch self { case .t2: 0.55; … } }
  }
  ```
  `allCases` is compiler-generated, so **a token cannot exist outside enumeration** — which is what
  makes the completeness half of A8 real. A hand-maintained `all` array would leave an omitted
  constant invisible to the test.
- **Fulfils:** A8

### 5. The drift test — bidirectional, normalised, honestly scoped
- **Files:** `app/Tests/MCPRouterKitTests/DesignTokenParityTests.swift`,
  `…/DesignDocParser.swift` — **Create**
- **Details:** Locate `DESIGN.md` by walking up from `#filePath` to the repo root; a missing file
  fails loudly, never skips. The parser is **heading-driven and per-table**, not one blanket
  column rule, because §2's tables differ in shape:

  | §2 table | Columns | Parse |
  |---|---|---|
  | Grounds and lines | 3 | name, value |
  | Label tiers | **4** | name, value, *(contrast — ignored, not a token)* |
  | Colour | 3 | name, value |
  | Type | 4 | role, size, line-height, emphasis |
  | Chrome geometry | 2 | element, value — **partially checked, see below** |

  Normalisation, each case chosen against a real construct in the document:
  - strip backticks **and markdown emphasis** — the type table writes `**Body**` where the others
    write a plain role;
  - **expand shorthand hex** — `#FFF` and `#FFFFFF` are the same colour and must compare equal;
  - case-fold hex; parse `@7.5%` → `0.075`; parse sizes to numbers;
  - skip header and separator rows explicitly.

  **Scope stated rather than silently narrowed.** Colours and the eight type roles are compared
  **strictly and bidirectionally**. Chrome geometry is compared only for rows that are unambiguous
  scalars (titlebar 33, sidebar 256, selection radius 8, popover radius 20). These rows are
  **listed in the test as deliberately not machine-checked** because they are prose, not values:
  `52pt (8 + 36 XL controls + 8)` (compound), `24–28pt for dense lists` (a range, and its dash is a
  typography edit away from a false failure), `rows 24/32/40`, `card radius 10–14`,
  `Mini 16 · Small 20 · Regular 24 · Large 28 · XL 36`. An explicit exclusion list a reader can
  see beats a parser that appears to cover them and quietly does not.
- **Verify:** green; then flip one constant and confirm it fails; then add a case with no document
  row and confirm the reverse direction fails; restore both. **Both red halves are required
  evidence** — a parity test never seen to fail in either direction is not known to work.
- **Fulfils:** A8, A9

### 6. Wire DTOs, errors, and the connection contract
- **Files:** `app/Sources/MCPRouterKit/Control/Models.swift`, `…/Control/ControlAPIError.swift`,
  `…/Control/ControlAPIClient.swift`, `…/Control/ServerPatch.swift`,
  `app/Tests/MCPRouterKitTests/ControlContractTests.swift` — **Create**
- **Details:** The seam: **wire shapes + error cases + the connection contract here; transport,
  sign-in, live updates and callable operations in F3.**
  - DTOs ported from `Models.swift`, checked against `describe()` in `src/control.ts`.
  - `ControlAPIError` with **`routerNotRunning` as its own case** — `DESIGN.md` §5 makes "the router
    is not running" a first-class state, and a client that cannot distinguish it cannot render it.
  - `ServerPatch` carrying **no `command`, `args` or `env`**. The guarantee is structural.
  - `ControlAPIClient` protocol only; no live implementation.
- **Verify:** **encode a fully-populated `ServerPatch` to JSON and assert the key set contains no
  `command`/`args`/`env`.** Encoding is the right oracle rather than `Mirror`: reflection sees only
  stored-property labels and would miss a computed property or a `CodingKeys` mapping that puts one
  of those keys on the wire.
- **Fulfils:** A16

### 7. Formatting helpers
- **Files:** `app/Sources/MCPRouterKit/Formatting/RelativeTime.swift`,
  `app/Tests/MCPRouterKitTests/RelativeTimeTests.swift` — **Create**
- **Details:** Port `shortAgo` and `projectLabel`, minus the SwiftUI `View` extension.
- **Verify:** boundary tests — 4s → "now", 59s, 60s, 3599s, 3600s, 86_399s, 86_400s.

### 8. Package gate
- **Verify:** `swift build --package-path app` and `swift test --package-path app` green; test
  count from `swift test list` is non-zero.
- **Fulfils:** A4

### 9. The XcodeGen spec
- **File:** `app/project.yml` — **Rewrite**
- **Details:**
  - `packages: MCPRouterKit: {path: .}`; both targets depend on the product.
  - **Per-target source paths, explicitly** — `MCPRouter` builds `MCPRouter/`, `MCPRouterIOS`
    builds `MCPRouterIOS/`. **Not `Sources`**: that path is the SwiftPM target's, and pointing an
    app target at it would compile the library twice and drag in whatever else sits there.
  - `MCPRouter` — macOS, deployment target `15.0`, bundle id `app.fledgeling.mcprouter`,
    `ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME: YES`, `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME: AppIcon`, and its
    `Assets.xcassets` in its sources.
  - `MCPRouterIOS` — iOS, deployment target `18.0`, bundle id `app.fledgeling.mcprouter.ios`.
  - Shared base settings retained from the old file: `SWIFT_VERSION: 6.0`,
    `SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY: complete`, `MARKETING_VERSION`, `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` — the last
    two feed the generated plists and the version the shells display.
  - **Remove `CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Manual` and `DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` from shared settings** — they force
    an identity no runner has and would fail every build. A `Release` configuration carries the
    Developer ID posture; `Debug` and CI build unsigned.
  - Info.plists generated from the `info:` block, not tracked.
- **Verify:** `xcodegen generate`; then `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` asserts, per target,
  `PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER`, the deployment target, `SWIFT_VERSION`, and (macOS)
  `ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME`. Assert the **entitlement files' own contents** for sandbox state —
  a build setting is not where the sandbox flag lives.
- **Fulfils:** A1, A6a, A6b, A7, A17, A18, A19

### 10. Entitlements
- **Files:** `app/MCPRouter/MCPRouter.entitlements`, `app/MCPRouterIOS/MCPRouterIOS.entitlements`
  — **Create**
- **Details:** macOS: `com.apple.security.app-sandbox` **false**, and **nothing else**.
  `com.apple.security.network.client` is dropped: it is an App Sandbox permission and grants
  nothing when the sandbox is off, so carrying it would be an entitlement the app does not use —
  the same rule the brief applies to iOS. iOS: an empty dictionary, since the companion needs no
  entitlement yet; the file exists so a later item adds to a reviewed baseline.
- **Verify:** parse both plists and assert the exact key sets.
- **Fulfils:** A6a, A7

### 11. The two launch shells
- **Files:** `app/MCPRouter/MCPRouterApp.swift`, `app/MCPRouterIOS/MCPRouterIOSApp.swift` — **Fill in**
- **Details:** Each renders **a value read from `MCPRouterKit`** — the ground colour from
  `ColorToken`, the body role from `TypeToken`, and the version. Ground `#1E1E1E`, primary label
  `--t1`, secondary `--t2`, body 13pt semibold, sentence case.

  Copy states plainly what the shell is: the app name, its version, and one sentence that the real
  surfaces arrive with the shell items. **No invented counts, no fake server list** — no number is
  displayed that the router does not observe, and this build observes none.
- **Verify:** build **Debug and Release, both unsigned**, macOS from a **cold `DerivedData`**, iOS
  against an **iOS Simulator destination**; launch each and screenshot. The screenshot must show
  the kit-sourced value on screen — that is what makes A5's sharing *proven* for that target rather
  than inferred from a successful link.
- **Fulfils:** A2, A3, A5, A15, A19

### 12. Lint and format config
- **Files:** `.swiftformat`, `.swiftlint.yml` — **Create**
- **Details:** Scoped to the Swift tree. Conservative rules that pass on this item's code; SwiftLint
  0.65 renamed rules, so confirm the config loads rather than copying an old one. Line length
  110 warn / 140 error.
- **Verify:** `swiftformat --lint app` and `swiftlint --strict` exit 0.
- **Fulfils:** A10

### 13. The Makefile
- **File:** `Makefile` — **Create**
- **Details:** `generate`, `build-mac`, `build-ios`, `test`, `lint`, `format`, `all`. Fail loudly on
  a missing tool.

  **`test` asserts that tests actually ran**, via `swift test list` — Swift Testing reports success
  for a suite that executed zero tests, so a target that stops matching test files still exits 0.
  Counting the enumerated list is stable across toolchain versions in a way that scraping
  human-readable run output is not.
- **Verify:** `make all` green; break one test and confirm non-zero; empty the test list and
  confirm the zero-test guard fires; restore.
- **Fulfils:** A11

### 14. CI
- **File:** `.github/workflows/swift.yml` — **Create**
- **Details:** macOS runner; install the three tools via Homebrew; run **the same Makefile targets**
  local development uses, so the two cannot drift. Both app targets unsigned; kit tests.
  Do **not** pin Xcode 26.6 — hosted runners lag, and macOS 15 / iOS 18 deployment targets need
  only Xcode 16+.
- **Verify:** YAML parses; every step has a locally-exercised Makefile equivalent. **Honest
  limitation: this cannot be proven green without pushing, and this item stops before push — so
  A12's evidence is the local equivalence run, and the workflow stays unproven on a real runner
  until the first push.**
- **Fulfils:** A12

### 15. SWIFT_PRACTICES.md
- **File:** `planning/practices/SWIFT_PRACTICES.md` — **Create**
- **Details:** Binding, in the house shape: agent protocol → rule sections → self-review checklist
  → sources. Grounded in what this item actually hit, not generic Swift advice: Swift 6 strict
  concurrency and `Sendable`; `Codable` at the wire boundary, decoding that **fails loudly on an
  unrecognised shape** (the flat-`servers.json` trap R1 inherits); no force-unwrap or `try!` outside
  tests; SwiftUI state ownership; never hardcode a colour or size — read the token registry;
  Keychain for secrets, never `UserDefaults`; entitlement minimalism per platform; an error taxonomy
  with the offline case first-class; and the testing rule that a zero-test suite is a failure.
- **Verify:** covers every rule this item's own code relies on; nothing contradicts
  `CODING_PRACTICES.md`.
- **Fulfils:** A13

## Parity inventory

A replacement path, so the old project's behaviours are enumerated rather than assumed to carry.

| Existing behaviour (`app/project.yml`, `app/Info.plist`) | Disposition |
|---|---|
| App Sandbox **off** (macOS) | **Keep** — restated in new entitlements (A6a) |
| Hardened runtime **on** | **Keep** — in build settings, where it lives (A6b) |
| `com.apple.security.network.client` | **Drop** — an App Sandbox permission; inert when the sandbox is off, so keeping it is an unused entitlement |
| `LSUIElement: false` + its reasoning comment | **Keep** — carried into the `info:` block |
| `NSSupportsAutomaticTermination/SuddenTermination: false` | **Keep** |
| `SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY: complete` | **Keep** — on the package *and* both app targets |
| `SWIFT_VERSION: 6.0` | **Keep** — explicitly on both app targets |
| `MARKETING_VERSION` / `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` | **Keep** — feed the generated plists and the version the shells display |
| `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME` + the AppIcon set | **Keep** — catalogue moves into the macOS target's sources |
| `INFOPLIST_KEY_NSPrincipalClass: NSApplication` | **Keep** — required for an AppKit-hosted SwiftUI app |
| `COMBINE_HIDPI_IMAGES: YES` | **Drop** — a legacy setting for `.tiff` image bundling; the asset catalogue supersedes it |
| `ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING: NO` | **Drop** — it was set for build phases this item does not have; re-add only when a script phase needs it |
| `CFBundleName/DisplayName: mcp-router` | **Keep** the values, regenerated from the `info:` block |
| Bundle id `gg.rhodes.mcp-router.app` | **Drop** — superseded by `app.fledgeling.mcprouter` |
| `CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Manual` + `DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` (shared) | **Drop** — would fail every unsigned build; posture moves to a Release configuration |
| `sources: Sources` (single path, both library and views) | **Drop** — replaced by explicit per-target source paths |
| `Theme` enum (system colours, off-ladder type) | **Drop** — contradicts `DESIGN.md` §2 |
| `shortAgo`, `projectLabel` | **Port** — step 7 |
| `Models.swift` DTOs | **Port** — step 6 |
| 13 SwiftUI product views | **Drop from this item** — M1–M8's surfaces; predate `DESIGN.md`; depend on F3's client. Kept in git history |

## Acceptance criteria

Spec A1–A19 is the durable checklist; each step carries a **Fulfils** line. The three most easily
faked, restated because they need a specific kind of evidence:

- [ ] A8/A9 — the parity test seen to fail in **both** directions (a drifted value; an
      unmapped case), then restored. Green-only proves nothing about a drift test.
- [ ] A15/A5 — a screenshot of each app **running** and showing a kit-sourced value. A build log is
      not evidence that a window drew.
- [ ] A11 — the zero-test guard seen to fire on an empty test list.

## Out of scope

- Archive, real code-signing, notarization, DMG packaging — posture configured (A19), not exercised.
  **Reported to the orchestrator as a deferred follow-on item**, not silently dropped.
- The SwiftUI component layer, asset catalogue colours, light appearance, control styles, the
  breaker, state containers — F2.
- Transport, Keychain auth, live updates, callable operations, recorded fixtures — F3.
- The Swift MCP SDK dependency and any router source — R1.
- `install.sh`, `src/*.ts` — untouched; TypeScript stays the installed default until R4.

Verdict on the first draft: **MATERIAL DEFECTS**. 18 findings, all accepted, all resolved above:

| Area | Finding | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| A8 | Hand-maintained `all` arrays are not enumerable by construction — an omitted constant is invisible | `CaseIterable` raw-value enums; `allCases` is compiler-generated (step 4) |
| A9 | Normalisation cannot represent compound/ranged geometry | Per-table parser; geometry scalars only, with the excluded prose rows **listed** (step 5) |
| A9 | `**Body**` vs `Body`; `#FFF` vs `#FFFFFF`; header/separator rows; 4-column label table | Strip emphasis, expand shorthand hex, skip header rows, per-table column rules (step 5) |
| A16 | `Mirror` misses computed properties and `CodingKeys` | Assert on the **encoded JSON** key set instead (step 6) |
| A5 | Symbol use proven only by compiling | Screenshot must show a kit-sourced value (step 11) |
| A2/A3/A19 | No cold `DerivedData`, no simulator destination, no Release build | All three named in step 11's verify |
| A6a/A7 | Entitlements verified via build settings, not the files | Step 10 parses both plists and asserts key sets |
| Ordering | Step 2's verify could not pass; generation preceded target sources | Shells created first (step 1); package verify moved to step 8 |
| Parity | `sources: Sources` would compile the library twice and drag in old views | Explicit per-target source paths (step 9) |
| Parity | `MARKETING_VERSION`, `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`, `SWIFT_VERSION`, strict concurrency, asset catalogue missing | All added to the inventory and step 9 |
| Parity | `INFOPLIST_KEY_NSPrincipalClass`, `COMBINE_HIDPI_IMAGES`, `ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING` undispositioned | Explicit Keep/Drop with reasons |
| Parity | `network.client` is inert without the sandbox | **Dropped**, with the reason recorded (step 10) |
| Assumption | "Discard Theme" had no deletion action | Step 2 deletes the superseded tree explicitly |
| Steps 5–6 | Promised tests had no test files | Test files named in the Files lists |
| A11 | Zero-test gate scraped human-readable output across floating toolchains | `swift test list` count (step 13) |
